scientific_integrity: Universal statements are justified by the analytic root-triangle, discrete-spectral and strict-gap arguments in RESULT.md; the finite checker is a corroboration, not an infinite proof. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to all translations, exactly three distinct equally weighted modulations, and normalized equal-power two-tap windows at a coprime separation. The comparison with previous literature is self-review and may miss an older unindexed equivalent result. The exhaustive checker covers finite N only.
title: Sharp three-channel finite Gabor conditioning for a two-tap window
